testimonials.title: What it changes, concretely
testimonials.subtitle: Three typical scenarios drawn from the areas I work in. The figures are realistic targets — the diagnostic establishes yours.

restaurant.text: Calls at all hours, bookings on Instagram, forgotten texts. A WhatsApp Business assistant asks the right questions (date, time, party size), confirms and sends a reminder the day before. Target: halve no-shows and win back an hour a day.

marketing.text: Hours spent on newsletters and LinkedIn posts. A supervised generation pipeline produces quality drafts in minutes; the team keeps control of strategy and tone. Target: publish three times more often, without hiring.

ecommerce.text: A customer service team buried under repetitive questions. A virtual assistant handles routine enquiries 24/7 and passes complex cases to the team. Target: automate around 70% of incoming requests.

seoIntro.title: Artificial Intelligence for Belgian and French SMEs
seoIntro.p1: In 2026, Artificial Intelligence is no longer reserved for large corporations. At AInspiration, we make AI accessible to all SMEs: restaurants, e-commerce businesses, consulting firms, marketing agencies, craftsmen and freelancers. Our mission is simple — save you time and money through intelligent automation solutions, with no technical skills required.
seoIntro.subtitle1: Concrete, measurable results from the first month
seoIntro.p2: The automations I deploy aim at time saved on repetitive tasks, measured on your own case rather than announced in advance. Whether it is automating bookings, generating marketing content, setting up a virtual assistant or improving your customer service, the solutions fit your trade and your specific needs.
seoIntro.p3: It all starts with a thirty-minute discovery call, with no commitment. If there is something to work on, the AI Diagnostic maps your processes over two days and returns three priority projects. Based in Givry, in Hainaut (Belgium), I support companies in Belgium and France in French, English and Dutch.
seoIntro.p4: All your data is hosted in Europe and processed in strict compliance with GDPR. We use cutting-edge technologies — intelligent chatbots, AI data analysis, content generation, smart CRM — while guaranteeing the confidentiality and security of your business information.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need technical skills to use your solutions?
faq.a1: Absolutely not! Our solutions are designed to be easy to use. We handle all the technical aspects.
faq.q2: How long does it take to implement an AI solution?
faq.a2: Most solutions are running within a few working days once the scope is agreed. The discovery call itself lasts thirty minutes.
faq.q3: Does the discovery call commit me to anything?
faq.a3: No. Thirty minutes to understand your situation. If there is nothing to be done, I will say so — that is also what makes the opinion worth having.
faq.a4: Absolutely. We are GDPR compliant and all data is hosted in Europe.
faq.q5: What type of business can benefit from your services?
faq.a5: Any SME can benefit! Restaurants, e-commerce, marketing agencies, consulting firms, craftsmen...
